description: This file contains unit tests for the DeleteAttributeStrategy class, which performs delete attribute operations on Thing objects within the Ditto system, validating behavior and error handling.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DeleteAttributeStrategy, verifying attribute deletion logic and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new DeleteAttributeStrategy instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the DeleteAttributeStrategy class is immutable.

methods.name: successfullyDeleteAttribute
methods.description: Tests successful deletion of an attribute from a Thing.

methods.name: deleteAttributeFromThingWithoutAttributes
methods.description: Tests deleting an attribute from a Thing that initially has no attributes, expecting an exception.

methods.name: deleteAttributeFromThingWithoutThatAttribute
